observation.visible_scene: Close-up of a glossy dark-brown sheet or film whose scalloped, wavy edge runs diagonally across the frame, resting on a white paper-like surface. Bright rainbow (iridescent) reflections trace the wavy edge. A few thin, curved brown shavings lie on the white area below the edge, and small bubble/dot marks are scattered on the brown surface. In later frames a separate brown lump appears at the far left border.
visible_changes: A slow lateral/diagonal camera movement pans across the scene: the wavy edge, the white-surface shavings, and the dot marks all shift together toward the right and upward in the frame, keeping roughly constant spacing, indicating translation of the viewpoint rather than independent object motion.

The rainbow reflection bands along the edge change position, shape and hue as the viewing angle shifts with the camera move, while the scalloped edge geometry itself stays essentially the same (no clear deformation).
A brown chunk gradually enters view at the left edge as the frame pans, becoming a persistent partial object on the left border in the latter half of the excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: The material identity of the brown sheet and of the left-edge lump.
Whether the sheet is physically moving at all or the apparent motion is purely camera translation.
What lies beyond the cropped left, top and right boundaries and before/after this segment.
uncertain_details: Cannot fully separate any tiny sheet movement from the dominant camera pan.
The cause of the iridescent color shifts (angle change vs. film motion) is not determinable from the frames alone.

camera movement, reflection from separate objects, expansion from translation, deformation from

and their relative positions before describing motion. Treat camera motion as uncertain when the
background evidence is insufficient, and retain clear relative changes despite that uncertainty.
